model.name: SprintPinResolver.resolveSprintPin
model.description: Pure resolveSprintPin(idx): {current,lastCompleted,nextBacklog}, each {uuid,number,name}|null. NUMBER-KEYED (never name-substring/\d+). current=the only Active (>=1 task derives In-Progress AND not superseded) sprint — QA-pending-only does NOT qualify (INV-C1-3); >1 Active = FAIL-LOUD ambiguous (INV-C1-4), never silent-pick; none->null. last-completed=highest-number fully-Done. next-backlog=lowest-number Planned with number>current.number. FAIL-CLOSED on vacuous (INV-C1-6): empty tasks[] != Done; an unresolvable task ref REFUSES that sprint with a named reason (never silent-skip); malformed checklist noted. R-C1. Design-ahead -> expert marks the decl.
